ex.s: As a new unit started, I asked everyone to write a persuasive piece on a health-related topic of their choice.
ex.t: 随着新单元开始，我让每个人就自己选择的健康相关话题写一篇说服性文章。

ex.s: In her first PE class , Eva was shocked when Coach Pitt announced that everyone had to run one mile around the track outside.

ex.s: Chances are that if you’re looking to live a more sustainable lifestyle, not everyone around you will be ready to jump on that bandwagon.
ex.t: 很可能，如果你想过上更可持续的生活，你周围并非所有人都会准备好跟上这股潮流。

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。

ex.s: Even though this technique won't work for everyone, it helps many people get a good store of ideas to draw on.
ex.t: 虽然这种技巧不一定对每个人都有效，但它帮助许多人积累了大量可供借鉴的想法。

ex.t: 在我的祖国意大利，意大利面和披萨是每个人午餐菜单上的食物。

ex.t: 创造变革的系统方法还建立在一种假设之上，即系统中的每个人都有平等的权力。

ex.t: 除了我之外，家里的每个人都很快适应了这个城市。

ex.t: 衣物交换的基本规则之一应该是：每个人在拿走衣服之前必须试穿——衣服穿在身上看起来总是不一样的。

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.
ex.t: “我经常给家人和朋友寄明信片，”他对《中国日报》说，“但你可以想象，过一阵子后，你收到的永远不会和你寄出的一样多，你会意识到不是每个人都像你一样热衷于它____32____”不过，为了寻找其他志同道合的人，保罗开始在一个不太可能的地方寻找：网上。

ex.s: For postcrossing to work worldwide, a common communication language is needed so that everyone can understand each other.
ex.t: 要让明信片交流在全球范围内运作，需要一种通用的交流语言，以便大家相互理解。

ex.s: There was a bit of me that didn't want to love this when everyone else on the planet did but the horror story is brilliant.
ex.t: 当地球上其他人都喜爱这本书时，我心里有一点不想爱上它，但这本恐怖小说太精彩了。

ex.s: “After all, everyone has bad days and good days," he said.
ex.t: "毕竟，每个人都有好日子和坏日子，"他说。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.t: 每个人都可以买外卖食物，但有时我们没有意识到自己做饭有多便宜。"

ex.s: Almost everyone gave up.
ex.t: 几乎每个人都放弃了。

ex.s: Everyone was silent, wait to see who would be called upon to read his and her paragraph aloud.
ex.t: 大家都安静地等待，看谁会被叫起来大声朗读自己的段落。

ex.s: Here are a few tips to help you win over everyone in the neighborhood quickly
ex.t: 这里有几个小贴士，能帮你迅速赢得邻里所有人的好感。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.t: 待一小时或待一周——这里有适合每个人的东西！

ex.s: Not everyone acts the same in response to events, and that is why what triggers one person may or may not trigger another.
ex.t: 并非每个人对事件的反应都一样，这正是触发一个人的事可能触发也可能不触发另一个人的原因。

ex.t: 40     每个人迟早都会回归大自然，这一定是真的。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

ex.s: If everyone is giving you the same answer, you won’t be able to use it.
ex.t: 如果每个人都给你同样的答案，你就没法利用它。

ex.s: She thinks everyone in the world is as nice as she is.
ex.t: 她认为世界上每个人都像她一样善良

ex.s: When vaccination rates are very high, as they still are in the nation as a whole, everyone is protected.
ex.t: 当接种率非常高时——全国整体目前仍然如此——每个人都会受到保护。

ex.s: When some refuse vaccination and seek a free ride, immunity breaks down and everyone is in even bigger danger.
ex.t: 当一些人拒绝接种疫苗想搭便车，免疫力就会崩溃，每个人都面临更大的危险。

ex.s: Everyone enjoys the life-saving benefits vaccines provide, but they’ll exist only as long as everyone shares in the risks.
ex.t: 每个人都享受着疫苗提供的救命益处，但只有当每个人都共同承担风险时，疫苗才能持续存在。

ex.s: Then we had all introduced ourselves, Mr Meng said, “Well done, everyone!
ex.t: 然后我们都做了自我介绍，孟先生说： “大家做得好！
